finding.assignments: PreProcess sets rowCount,columnCount,rowIndices,columnStarts,blockSize and later attributes.kind. Other attribute fields are never assigned before direct SparseFactor.
finding.consequence: The direct API receives indeterminate attributes. Transpose can change ordinary/QR matrix semantics; triangle selects the symmetric half; the SDK requires reserved bits zero and caller-owned allocation flag zero. This is static proof of missing initialization, not a dynamically reproduced numerical error.
finding.construction: Implementation is dynamically allocated with its user-provided constructor; SMS has no member initializer and the constructor performs no aggregate initialization. SDK types are C structs with scalar members and no default member initializers. No guaranteed zero initialization occurs.
finding.not_rescued_by_sdk: The explicit-options SparseFactor wrapper forwards Matrix and options to its QR/symmetric implementation without filling matrix attributes.

minimal_recommendation.effect: Defines reserved/allocation bits as zero and explicitly fixes transpose/triangle. Existing assignments subsequently define all dimensions/pointers/blockSize/kind. Fits the same contiguous hunk as the CSC repair; no general patch-parser expansion is needed.
minimal_recommendation.location: Inside existing macOS availability block in PreProcess, immediately before current SMS.columnCount assignment (upstream line207), after the preserved zero-row/CSC pointer correction.
minimal_recommendation.restriction: Iterative mode remains excluded; this finding does not declare full adapter or numerical physics validation.
minimal_recommendation.triangle_basis: This FEBio CSC path stores both halves, so the upper half exists. SDK SparseUpperTriangle=0 matches aggregate-zero value; explicit selection makes the convention auditable. For SparseOrdinary, SDK documents triangle as ignored.
